# Synthetic Failure Case: Foundational Concept Treated As Given

This fixture is invented for regression testing. It does not contain private
application text.

## Expected Audit Results

- Foundational concept is treated as established without adequate introduction
  or literature anchoring.
- Missing or weak background
- Inadequate literature anchoring
- Recommendation to introduce and support the foundational concept

## Proposal Text

The proposed platform depends on reversible thermal ratcheting, which makes
continuous micro-positioning possible in confined spaces. Aim 1 will optimize
the ratcheting response, Aim 2 will build a control model, and Aim 3 will
integrate the platform into a compact device.

The proposal does not introduce reversible thermal ratcheting, explain whether
it is established or speculative, or provide literature support for why it can
serve as the foundation of the project.
